_comment: Generic example for vault grounding (Story 10.47). Copy fields into ~/.claude/sinapse-ai-config.yaml under grounding.vault — or just run `npx sinapse-ai install --reconfigure` and the wizard handles it.

vault._comment_path: Absolute path to the root of your notes vault. Obsidian, Logseq, or any flat-markdown layout works.
vault._comment_domains: Optional filter — only inject notes tagged with these domains. Leave empty to allow all.
